author: Bobby Grayson
title: Final shape: ONE blocker per helper, carrying EVERY family inside it. Per-family findings (node 776) told the truth about distance but pushed the blocker total from 738 to 1111, destroying the round-to-round comparability of the one number the gate watches -- for a change that is a measurement definition, not a translator regression. Splitting the two: a blocker stays the unit of work (the helper, call sites collapsed, count unchanged), while families_of/1 returns a LIST so distance counts features. LoomWeb.TeamCostComponent: 2 blockers, distance 8. EnsembleWeb.SentryLive: 11 blockers, distance 13 (it read 2). LoomWeb.CostDashboardLive: 1 blocker, distance 1, and the family is now 'call to Metrics' rather than 'local helper is not a pure expression'. One blocker may count under several families in the by-family table, which is what that table is for.
